agreement.title: Tester agreement
agreement.page.1:
<bold>Welcome, tester!</bold>

Thanks for testing KronlandMC before launch.

Everything you see here is <bold>confidential</bold>: no screenshots, videos or details outside.
agreement.page.2:
<bold>Reporting bugs</bold>

Use /bug to report bugs. Location, server and version are attached automatically.

Never abuse <bold>exploits</bold> (duping, money, permissions) – report them right away as severity "Exploit". Only the team sees them.
agreement.page.3:
<bold>Data</bold>

Before release we reset crowns, plots, cards and progress.

Confirmed bugs earn points, the "Beta tester" badge and a release reward.
agreement.page.choice:
<bold>Agreed?</bold>

Until you accept, you stay where you are.
agreement.accepted: <tc:success>Agreement accepted – have fun testing! Report bugs with <tc:accent>/bug</tc:accent>.
agreement.frozen: <tc:warn>Heads up: accept the tester agreement first – <tc:accent>/testervereinbarung</tc:accent>.
agreement.kick:
<tc:accent>KronlandMC</tc:accent>

<tc:text>Too bad – without the tester agreement you cannot play during the test phase.
See you at launch on kronland.de!
